reason: Tally handles our fees, the class teachers mark attendance in registers and Excel, and WhatsApp groups reach every parent already. I have never paid for school software and a list of 14 modules sounds like a big switch for my staff, not a small fix.
objection: We only need fees and attendance, not 14 modules. Moving our fee data out of Tally and training teachers and parents on a new app, from a company I have never heard of, is real work and a real risk in the middle of a session, and if they shut down my data goes with them.
would_change_my_mind: Another principal I know in a nearby CBSE school running fees and attendance on it for a full session, plus someone who comes and moves our Tally fee data for us, with just those two modules at around Rs 10,000 a year.
